question: What special name is given to the frictional force exerted by a fluid?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Drag.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Drag forces appear whenever there is motion in air or water or in any other fluid.
 
• The drag forces always act in the** opposite direction to fluid flow.**
 
• Example-Drag on a ship moving in the water.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
 

 
 
Drag

 
 
 
The frictional force exerted by fluids is also called drag

 
 
 

 
 
Buoyancy

 
 
 
An upward force exerted by any fluid to oppose the weight of an immersed object is called upthrust or buoyancy

 
 
 

 
 
Upthrust

 
 
 
An upward force exerted by any fluid to oppose the weight of an immersed object is called upthrust or buoyancy

 
 
 

 
 
Convection

 
 
 
Transfer of heat due to bulk movement of molecules in fluids such as liquid or gas is called convection.
